description: Scan copy for affirmative performance claims of the kind that get finance, health and other regulated advertising rejected: guaranteed profit, stated win rates, promised returns. A disclaimer is not flagged when its negation governs the claim itself, shortly before it in the same clause (不保證獲利, 'we do not guarantee profit', 'no guaranteed returns'), or when the phrase is named as forbidden ('guaranteed profit claims are banned'). A negation elsewhere in the sentence does not count: 保證獲利，絕不會虧損 is still a claim.

text.description: Plain text or HTML. HTML tags are ignored.

name: check_claims
